name: Build assets
description: Leaf that produces the assets the scenes draw from — captured real-UI plates, images, characters, or 3D assets the storyboard calls for.
produce: Produce the assets the scenes draw from: capture the real-UI plates (one plate-capture can yield several plates) and generate or specify the images, characters, or 3D assets the storyboard calls for. Output the asset set, not a scene.
